verses.text: A Psalm of David, in his being in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You [are] my God; I seek after You—my soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You—in a land dry and weary, without waters.

segments.text: A Psalm of David, in his being in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You [are] my God; I seek after You—my soul thirsts for You, my flesh longs for You—in a land dry and weary, without waters.

verses.text: So in the sanctuary I have seen You, to behold Your power and Your glory.

segments.text: So in the sanctuary I have seen You, to behold Your power and Your glory.

verses.text: Because Your loving devotion [is] better than life, my lips will praise You.

segments.text: Because Your loving devotion [is] better than life, my lips will praise You.

verses.text: So I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift up my hands.

segments.text: So I will bless You in my life; in Your name I will lift up my hands.

verses.text: As [with] milk and fatness, my soul is satisfied, and with lips of joyful shouts, my mouth will praise You,

segments.text: As [with] milk and fatness, my soul is satisfied, and with lips of joyful shouts, my mouth will praise You,

verses.text: when I remember You on my bed, through the watches of the night I meditate on You.

segments.text: when I remember You on my bed, through the watches of the night I meditate on You.

verses.text: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I will shout [for joy].

segments.text: For You have been a help to me, and in the shadow of Your wings I will shout [for joy].

verses.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand has taken hold of me.

segments.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand has taken hold of me.

verses.text: And those [who] seek my soul for desolation, they will go into the depths of the earth.

segments.text: And those [who] seek my soul for desolation, they will go into the depths of the earth.

verses.text: They will fall by the hand of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

segments.text: They will fall by the hand of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.

verses.text: And the king will rejoice in God; everyone swearing by Him will exult, but the mouth of those speaking lies will be stopped up.
